strings.name: Asghar Farhadi
strings.summary: Farhadi portrays Iranian daily life through family conflict, class and moral choices, building narratives from competing explanations. A Separation and The Salesman won foreign-language Oscars for Iran, alongside recognition in Berlin and Cannes. He also works across French and Spanish settings. A Hero faced plagiarism allegations, rejected by an Iranian court in 2024; in 2026 he presented Parallel Tales.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through films such as A Separation, he approaches social structures through family ethics, bringing Iranian everyday-life narratives to global attention.

strings.facts.f2.label: Education and beginnings
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied drama at the University of Tehran and earned a stage-directing master’s at Tarbiat Modares University.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Two Oscar-winning films
strings.highlights.h1.text: A Separation and The Salesman won the 2012 and 2017 foreign-language Oscars respectively.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Moral narratives of everyday life
strings.highlights.h2.text: Builds multiple perspectives from family, law and social pressures in Iranian and international productions.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Presented Parallel Tales at Cannes
strings.timeline.t1.text: The French-language film entered the 2026 competition, exploring reality, fiction and artistic creation.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Received favorable plagiarism ruling
strings.timeline.t2.text: Court reporting said the A Hero plagiarism allegation was rejected; the earlier accusation was not a conviction.
strings.timeline.t3.title: A Hero won Cannes Grand Prix
strings.timeline.t3.text: The film about debt, reputation and public opinion received the festival’s Grand Prix.
strings.timeline.t4.title: The Salesman won an Oscar
strings.timeline.t4.text: Won Best Foreign Language Film, becoming his second film to receive the award.
strings.timeline.t5.title: A Separation won an Oscar
strings.timeline.t5.text: Received Best Foreign Language Film after earlier winning Berlin’s Golden Bear.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Won Berlin recognition for About Elly
strings.timeline.t6.text: The seaside disappearance drama earned the Silver Bear for Best Director.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Made feature debut
strings.timeline.t7.text: Released Dancing in the Dust after working in shorts, theater and television.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed postgraduate directing training
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed stage-directing master’s studies, later bringing theater training to cinema.
